name: Sarnafast® KTL
tagline: Metal washer for spot fastening in overlaps and intermediate fastening in mechanically fastened roofing systems
summary: Zinc plated steel washes with diamond-shaped reinforcement and specially stamped barbs for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Hole diameter 7.5 mm.
metaDescription:
Zinc plated steel washes with diamond-shaped reinforcement and specially stamped barbs for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes.
Hole diameter 7.5 mm.
attributes: Easy to use and install with recommended tools
usage: Mechanically fastened roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with fastener Sarnafast® SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0. Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over compressible thermal insulation (not for use on hard substrates).
advantages: Easy to use and install with recommended tools
packaging: Loose, packaging unit 250 pieces / box Article No.: 111097

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Quality Management System EN ISO 9001/14001
European Technical Approval ETA-08/0262
Factory Mutual Class No. 4470

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Sarnafast® KTL does not expire during correct storage.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Sarnafast® KTL shall be stored in dry conditions.

items.label: Dimensions
items.text: 82 × 40 mm, hole diameter 7.5 mm, thickness 1 mm

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Ancillary products:
Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-6.0
Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-S-6.0

items.label: Corrosion resistance
items.text: 15 cycles Kesternich test (concentration SFW 2.0 S in accordance with DIN 50018) according to ETAG 006 – D.3.1.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Installation works to be carried out only by experienced Sika trained roofing contractors.
Additional measures may be required for installation at below +5 °C ambient temperature in accordance with all relevant local regulations.
